newsitem.title: POLAND: TRAVEL AGENCY OFFERS POLISH DISASTER TOUR - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: TRAVEL AGENCY OFFERS POLISH DISASTER TOUR - PAPER.

text.p: A Warsaw travel agency is offering special air tours over areas of Poland ravaged by the worst flood disaster in centuries, Gazeta Wyborcza newspaper reported on Friday.
"You can see the floods for yourself from the air -- not just on television," the top-selling daily quoted the agency literature as saying.
"The power of disaster -- once every five hundred years," enthused the agency, which was not named by the newspaper.
Prices range from a single passenger aircraft at 550 zlotys ($160) an hour up to an 18-seat plane for hire at $1,750 which can bring eager spectators from as far away as Madrid.
The agency promised that as soon as roads were passable it would offer two-day road tours with English-language guides.
The floods have killed 55 people. Almost 3,000 sq kms were still inundated, including hundreds of towns and villages.
Hundreds of thousands of people are now battling to avoid illness and come to terms with the loss of homes, crops and modest possessions built up over a lifetime.
